specificationName: Complete MCP Data Flow for Activity and Impulse System

changesApplied.changeMade: Implemented complete MCP tool for dynamic variant creation with POST to /v2/activities/variants
changesApplied.reason: Enables trailblazing and template evolution. Without this: trailblazing broken, no dynamic variants, learning loop stuck with static templates

impactAnalysis.blastRadius: LOW - New tool, no existing code depends on it
impactAnalysis.risk: Backend endpoint missing (will gracefully fail until backend implements)

changesApplied.dataFlow: Trailblazing.createVariant() → MCP.callTool('metabob_create_activity_variant') → CLI tool → httpx.post('/v2/activities/variants') → Backend → SurrealDB activity_template

changesApplied.changeMade: Implemented complete MCP tool for ML-driven activity recommendations with POST to /v2/activities/recommend
changesApplied.reason: Enables intelligent template selection based on task similarity and impulse context. Without this: agent picks templates blindly, no ML optimization

dependencies: Backend ML service (embedding search + Thompson Sampling)
impactAnalysis.blastRadius: LOW - New tool, no existing code depends on it
impactAnalysis.risk: Backend endpoint missing + ML service required

changesApplied.dataFlow: ActivitySelector.recommend() → MCP.callTool('metabob_recommend_activities') → CLI tool → httpx.post('/v2/activities/recommend') → Backend embedding search → Thompson Sampling → ranked templates

changesApplied.changeMade: Implemented complete MCP tool for impulse learning with POST to /v2/impulses/recommend
changesApplied.reason: Enables impulse usefulness measurement and learning loop closure. Without this: no impulse feedback, cannot measure effectiveness, learning loop incomplete

consumers: Impulse management system in OpenCode (when integrated)
impactAnalysis.blastRadius: LOW - New tool, no existing code depends on it
impactAnalysis.risk: Backend endpoint missing + usage analytics required

changesApplied.dataFlow: ImpulseLearning.recommend() → MCP.callTool('metabob_recommend_impulses') → CLI tool → httpx.post('/v2/impulses/recommend') → Backend impulse_usage queries → ranked impulse types

maintained: MCP-only communication (all tools proxy to backend via HTTP)
Proper error handling (timeout, network, API errors)
Graceful degradation (returns error status, doesn't throw)

infrastructureRequired: SurrealDB schema for variant storage (with parent linkage)
Embedding search service for task similarity
Thompson Sampling implementation for template selection

downstreamUpdates.change: Add calls to metabob_create_activity_variant when generating recovery strategies
downstreamUpdates.desiredState: Variants persisted to backend for reuse across sessions

downstreamUpdates.change: Add calls to metabob_recommend_activities for intelligent template selection
downstreamUpdates.currentState: Manual template selection or simple search

downstreamUpdates.change: Add calls to metabob_recommend_impulses to measure usefulness
downstreamUpdates.currentState: No feedback loop for impulse effectiveness

unitTests: metabob_recommend_impulses returns empty array on error
integrationTests: Variant creation persists to SurrealDB activity_template table
e2eTests: Trailblazing creates variant and stores in backend

nextActions.task: Set up embedding search service for task similarity
Write integration tests for new data flows
Deploy backend changes and verify SurrealDB schema

lessonsLearned: Architectural compliance first: Previous enforcement removed HTTP code but didn't validate MCP tools existed
Backend coordination required: MCP tools are easy to implement, but backend endpoints are the real work
Graceful degradation: Tools return errors instead of failing, allowing partial functionality
Specification gaps: The trace identified missing tools; enforcement implemented them. Both steps were necessary
